notes.title: Online Leaderboard!!!! And All New Updated Adventure Mode! - V0.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Long awaited, but finally here. The online leaderboard! 

Try and get your name into the top 10 of 4 various game modes!

A big haul into adventure mode has also taken place! The same concept is there, but with more of a fun twist! You have to navigate through a solar system map, to choose which galaxies to enter to ensure you get enough trophies before heading to the next area.

Some balancing of trophies and money for a lot of lands have also had to happen.

notes.title: Mini Fall update and Adventure Mode! - V0.0.5 Update
notes.content:
​Big update here!

Now added to the game in the Adventure Mode! Play this rogue-like type game mode that adds so many new features to the game! 

New Features:

    -Inventory: The lands that show up in the shop are now lands from your inventory! You can collect more lands or remove them based on how you would like to play!
    -Different Goals: Each area has multiple different goals you need to complete in order to get rewards. These can be from getting a certain amount of trophies, to trying to get one planet to have all the same type of land.
    -Medals: Enhance the game play by collecting medals, which stick with you through your run! There powerful items can really make or break a run if you can get them!
    -Dangers: Get far enough in a run and you'll encounter some dangers! These are effects that happen in specific star formations (levels) you get to. Sometimes a Rock Land will spawn and get in your way, or a constant wind will blow slowly moving your camera!

​Right now Adventure Mode is an Alpha build, so there might still be some issues, and there is a lot more to add, clean up.

New Lands:

    -Maze Land
    -Leaf Land
    -Latte Land
    -Hay Land
    -Pumpkin Land
    -Jigsaw Land
    -Bomb Land

​

Things To Add Next:

    -Story for Adventure Mode
    -Achievements
        -Achievements will unlock fun collectables and things in the player hub
    -New main menu screen - It's going to be a hub, and you will see above mentioned collectables
    -More Lands
